question: What conduct should a practitioner with an equal mind abandon through sustained practice?
premises: Practice leads to an equal mind
Village dharma represents conventional social duty
The practitioner is instructed to abandon it
inference: Through practice, one with an equal mind should abandon village dharma
uncertainties: grāma-dharma may refer broadly to conventional worldly duties
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the duties of village life.
